active_problem: NBA application product routes are hosted by Runless instead of the Kyre Sports API gateway, preventing a clean reusable NBA domain for future pages.
repair: Registered a reusable /api/v1/nba domain on Kyre Sports API, migrated all five current PRA product routes into sports_api/api, repointed every NBA application client from Runless to Kyre Sports API, and hardened FanDuel PRA market-name normalization without fabricating data.

repair_history.finding: Runless preflight rejected missing future artifact paths before a proof row was created.
repair_history.resolution: RED manifest narrowed to artifacts that already exist.
RED harness changed missing successor-module imports into assertion failures so the sandbox can classify the intended product contract failure.

repair_history.root_cause: The gateway status manifest correctly named ESPN BET as prohibited policy, but the new active-route test scanned the manifest itself for banned-provider literals and treated the policy declaration as a provider dependency.
repair_history.resolution: Separate the policy-only gateway manifest from product-serving route dependency checks; product routes remain banned-source free while the manifest explicitly declares prohibited sources.
